title: Island Guide Content
description: Content model for island pages (children of the 'Galapagos Islands' parent page). SEO meta (title, description, focus keyword, canonical) is handled by Rank Math / Yoast — NOT here.

fields.label: GEO / AI Answer (on-page)
fields.name: geo_answer
fields.instructions: Short ~50-word answer shown on the page, optimized for AI / featured snippets. This is VISIBLE on-page content, not a meta tag.

fields.label: Intro / Overview
fields.name: intro
fields.instructions: Lead paragraph that opens the guide, shown before 'At a Glance'. Populated from the document's opening text.

fields.label: Author / Byline
fields.name: author
fields.instructions: Display byline from the document, e.g. 'Juan Magallanes, Naturalist Expert Contributor'. Leave blank when the doc has no byline — do NOT fall back to the WordPress post author (the uploader); the byline simply stays empty.

fields.label: Quick Facts — Title
fields.name: quick_facts_title
fields.instructions: Section heading, e.g. 'At a Glance' / 'The Island at a Glance'.

fields.label: Quick Facts — Intro
fields.name: quick_facts_intro
fields.instructions: Optional lead text under the heading (if the doc has any).

fields.label: Quick Facts
fields.name: quick_facts
fields.instructions: Display data only (Location, Area, Main town, Access…). Keep SEO meta out of here.

sub_fields.label: Icon (SVG/Image)
sub_fields.name: icon
sub_fields.instructions: Upload your own icon per page (SVG recommended — every Font Awesome icon can be downloaded as an SVG). Needs the free Safe SVG plugin for SVG uploads.

fields.label: Feature Sections
fields.name: feature_sections
fields.instructions: Editorial / thematic stories (geology, history, conservation, what makes this island special). NOT the place-by-place catalog — that is Visitor Sites.

fields.label: Visitor Sites — Title
fields.name: visitor_sites_title
fields.instructions: Section heading, e.g. 'Visitor Sites on Santa Cruz'.

fields.label: Visitor Sites — Intro (Land-Based)
fields.name: visitor_sites_intro
fields.instructions: Lead text for the Land-Based visitor sites (or the single Visitor Sites section).

fields.label: Visitor Sites — Intro (Cruise-Only)
fields.name: visitor_sites_intro_cruise
fields.instructions: Lead text for the Cruise-Only visitor sites section, when the island has a separate one (e.g. Isabela).

fields.label: Visitor Sites
fields.name: visitor_sites
fields.instructions: Place-by-place catalog. 'Species Seen' is only a short pointer — the full species profile lives in the Wildlife tab.

sub_fields.label: Species Seen (short list)
sub_fields.name: species_seen
sub_fields.instructions: Short mention only, e.g. 'marine iguanas, sea lions, penguins'. Full profiles go in the Wildlife tab.

fields.label: Wildlife — Title
fields.name: wildlife_title
fields.instructions: Section heading, e.g. 'Wildlife at Punta Espinoza'.

fields.label: Wildlife — Intro
fields.name: wildlife_intro
fields.instructions: Intro/overview for the Wildlife section (the H2 lead text).

fields.label: Wildlife Species
fields.name: wildlife
fields.instructions: Species profiles (organized by species, not by place).

fields.label: Wildlife Calendar (season → highlights)
fields.name: wildlife_calendar
fields.instructions: Seasonal 'what to see when' calendar (e.g. Santiago). Each row is a period with its wildlife highlights.

sub_fields.label: Getting There — Heading
sub_fields.name: getting_there_title
sub_fields.instructions: The document's H2 for this block (e.g. 'Getting to Isabela'). Kept so the editorial title is not lost.

sub_fields.label: Where to Stay / When to Visit — Heading
sub_fields.name: stay_visit_title
sub_fields.instructions: The document's H2 for the stay + best-time block (e.g. 'Where to Stay and When to Visit').

fields.label: Plan Your Visit — Heading
fields.name: cta_title
fields.instructions: Section heading above the CTAs (e.g. 'Plan Your Visit'). Populated from the doc's 'Plan Your Visit' section.

fields.label: Plan Your Visit — Intro
fields.name: cta_intro
fields.instructions: Lead text under the heading, above the CTA blocks.

fields.label: CTA Blocks
fields.name: cta
fields.instructions: Supports more than one CTA (e.g. direct travelers + travel trade / DMC).

sub_fields.label: Background image (optional)
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: Per-island background photo for this card. The text stays over the card colour and the photo fades in from the side. Leave blank for a solid-colour card.

fields.label: Sources / Citations
fields.name: sources
fields.instructions: Authority references (GNPD, CDF, IUCN…). Feeds E-E-A-T and schema.

fields.label: Related Links (internal)
fields.name: related_links
fields.instructions: Internal linking block ('Explore More'). Optional — can also be handled in the Elementor template.
